tools.title: Built-in tool registry exposes context and input tools
tools.test: The task tool layer must expose request_user_input plus MCP resource list/template/read tools without removing the existing planning, skill, collaboration, and agent-job tools.

steps.instruction: Inspect the TypeScript task tool registry and MCP tool modules after implementation.
steps.expected: ToolRegistry task tools include request_user_input, list_mcp_resources, list_mcp_resource_templates, and read_mcp_resource.
steps.descript: The task layer registers request_user_input and the MCP resource tools.
evidence: packages/ndx/src/tools/registry.ts imports requestUserInputTool and mcpResourceTools and adds them in taskTools().
packages/ndx/src/tools/mcp/resources.ts defines list_mcp_resources, list_mcp_resource_templates, and read_mcp_resource.
Built registry smoke printed request_user_input, list_mcp_resources, list_mcp_resource_templates, read_mcp_resource, and spawn_agent.

steps.expected: The build completes with the new tool definitions typed correctly.
evidence: Command completed with exit code 0: yarn workspace @neurondev/ndx-core build

subagents.title: Collaboration tools use a TypeScript sub-agent controller
subagents.test: Collaboration tools must no longer return placeholder unavailable output; spawn_agent, send_input, wait_agent, close_agent, resume_agent, and list_agents should call a real in-process controller.

steps.instruction: Inspect collaboration tool implementations and the agent runtime wiring.
steps.expected: The tools call a shared controller through ToolContext, and AgentRuntime passes the controller into runAgent.
steps.descript: Collaboration tools dispatch to ToolContext.agentController and runtime passes a shared controller into runAgent.
evidence: packages/ndx/src/tools/collaboration/agents.ts dispatches spawn_agent, send_input, resume_agent, wait_agent, close_agent, and list_agents to context.agentController.
packages/ndx/src/tools/collaboration/agent-jobs.ts dispatches spawn_agents_on_csv and report_agent_job_result to context.agentController.
packages/ndx/src/runtime/runtime.ts creates a sub-agent controller and passes agentController into the injected runAgent call.
packages/ndx/src/agent/subagents.ts implements createSubAgentController.

steps.instruction: Run a small built output script that spawns a mock child agent, waits for it, lists it, and closes it.
steps.expected: The script observes JSON outputs with real agent ids and terminal child status rather than status=unavailable.
steps.descript: The smoke script spawned, waited, listed, and closed a mock child agent.
evidence: Smoke output: spawnStatus=running, waitStatus=completed, finalText=mock agent completed, listedCount=1, closeStatus=closed.
The smoke script imported packages/ndx/dist/agent/subagents.js and used MockModelClient plus runAgent.

artifacts.title: Artifact classification is documented and reflected in loop context
artifacts.test: The package must document how historical Codex Rust differentiated model-visible resources from UI artifacts, and the NDX loop must inject only concrete local artifact references into turn context.

steps.instruction: Inspect the new artifact analysis markdown document.
steps.expected: The document cites Rust paths for UserInput, contextual fragments, thread history items, MCP resource reads, and explains that UI artifacts are not blindly injected into model context.
steps.descript: The new artifact document records the Rust resource boundary and NDX contract.
evidence: packages/ndx/docs/agent-artifact-context.md cites codex-rs/protocol/src/user_input.rs, codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs, codex-rs/core/src/context/fragment.rs, app-server-protocol/src/protocol/thread_history.rs, and MCP resource read paths.
packages/ndx/docs/agent-artifact-context.md states that UI thread artifacts are not a blanket future prompt inclusion rule.

steps.instruction: Inspect the NDX agent loop context code.
steps.expected: The loop scans model-visible history and the prompt for existing local artifact references and adds a bounded user context message before the prompt.
steps.descript: The loop adds bounded referenced artifact context for existing local files under cwd.
evidence: packages/ndx/src/agent/loop/artifacts.ts limits artifacts to existing files under cwd and caps the list at 8 with 1200-character text excerpts.
packages/ndx/src/agent/loop/state.ts inserts artifactContextMessages before skill messages and the user prompt.
Artifact smoke emitted a # Referenced Artifacts message for packages/ndx/docs/agent-artifact-context.md with path, size, modified_at, and excerpt.

documentation.title: Package docs record new loop subsystem contracts
documentation.test: Package docs must describe the new built-in tools, sub-agent controller, artifact context behavior, and the verification suite.

steps.instruction: Inspect packages/ndx README and docs pages after implementation.
steps.expected: README navigation links the new artifact analysis doc, architecture/internals/api/testing docs describe the new contracts, and testing docs reference this suite.
steps.descript: Package documentation records the new agent loop subsystem contracts.
evidence: packages/ndx/README.md links docs/agent-artifact-context.md.
packages/ndx/docs/architecture.md lists artifacts.ts and subagents.ts.
packages/ndx/docs/internals.md records explicit resource/artifact context and sub-agent control plane ownership.
packages/ndx/docs/api.md documents built-in MCP resource tools, collaboration controller behavior, and Referenced Artifacts context.
packages/ndx/docs/testing.md references test/20260508/201728_agent-loop-subsystems.json.

deployment.title: Repository deploy contract still passes
deployment.test: The standard repository deploy command must complete after the agent loop subsystem changes.

steps.instruction: Run npm run deploy from the repository root.
steps.expected: The deploy script completes successfully, including build, agenttest policy hook, Docker compose refresh, sandbox write verification, and teardown.
evidence: Command completed with exit code 0: npm run deploy.
Deploy output ran Turbo build for @neurondev/ndx, @neurondev/ndx-core, @neurondev/ndx-toolcontainer, and @neurondev/ndxserver-app.
Deploy output ran the agenttest policy hook: agenttest policy: strict JSON results under test/YYYYMMDD.
